title: Novembrium 25
description: A vast almost realistic world made for city-building and connecting places together with roads and trainlines.
body:
First online modpack.

![Cover image in a glassy Minecraft Title setting with title "Novembrium" and subtitle "2025" in front of a blurred background of an interior.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a840f1713d4e33a9d723d01a5ad9993988608a23_0.webp)

A vast, _almost_ realistic modpack made with city/nation-building in mind. Utilises connecting places together with roads, trainlines and more.

### World generation
Such as **Terralith** and **Tectonic** for more realistic control over terrain.

### Technology and creativity
Features **Create** and some associating mods like **Create Deco**, **Create Nuclear**, **Create Crafts & Additions** and many more.

Designed mostly for creative game mode. Play as survival mode for a more adventurous and challenging play.
